pilotMechanism.summary: Glen Rock utilizes virtually zero long-term PILOT abatements, ensuring that all downtown commercial storefronts and professional offices along Rock Road contribute standard property taxes directly to the Glen Rock Public Schools and Bergen County.

taxAppeals.lossMitigation: Proactive assessment defenses maintained by Certified Tax Assessor William Yirce.

taxpayerSolutions: Expanding downtown outdoor dining and retail ratables along Rock Road.
Shared service interlocal agreements with Ridgewood and Bergen County for specialized equipment.
